_readme: Giving campaigns for /donate and /campaigns. Add an object to add a campaign; set active to false to close one. Fields: slug (url-safe, becomes /campaigns/<slug>), title, summary (one or two sentences for cards), body (list of paragraphs), funds (list of short lines: what the money pays for), image (site path, optional), goal (whole dollars, optional), raised (whole dollars, set by hand, optional), deadline (YYYY-MM-DD, optional), active (true/false), defaultFrequency (monthly or one-time), alwaysOpen (true shows the Always open tag). Copy marked [TBD] is placeholder for Encore to replace.

campaigns.title: General Support
campaigns.summary: Give where it helps most. Funds scholarships, production costs and our free sensory-friendly and ASL-interpreted performances across the whole season.
body: General support is the most flexible gift you can make. It goes wherever the need is greatest that season, from a scholarship that lets a young artist say yes to an audition, to the lights, costumes and sets that turn a rehearsal into a show.
It also keeps our free sensory-friendly and ASL-interpreted performances free, so every family in southern Utah has a seat in the house.
funds: Production costs: costumes, sets, lights and sound

campaigns.title: 2027 Build Campaign
campaigns.summary: Help us build the 2027 season. Our goal is $20,000 by December 31, 2026.
